title: Monster in My Family
description:
S02 E02 — The Nightstalker: Richard Ramirez
Richard Ramirez's ex-sister-in-law and niece come to terms with the evil that existed in their family and meet a survivor of one of Richard's attacks.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S02 E04 — The Craigslist Killer: Richard Beasley
Richard Beasley's daughter Tonya lives with the guilt of teaching her father how to post ads on Craigslist; Tonya meets a man whose father was one of Beasley's four victims.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S02 E03 — The Orlando Shooter: Omar Mateen
On June 12, 2016, Omar Mateen killed 49 people in an Orlando nightclub; Omar's first wife, Sitora Yusufiy, meets a man whose brother was killed in the nightclub attack.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E04 — DC Sniper: John Allen Muhammad
Mildred Muhammad, ex-wife of the infamous DC Sniper, reveals how the man she loved disintegrated into a monster; Melissa Moore interviews Lee Boyd Malvo in prison.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S02 E01 — Drew Peterson
Drew Peterson's eldest son Stephen shares memories about his father; Stephen reaches out to his former step-mother's sister to offer his condolences for his father's heinous actions.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E05 — Classified Ad Rapist: Bobby Joe Long
A woman discusses how her childhood sweetheart turned into a murdering rapist; being a child of a serial killer.

title: Monster in My Family
description:
S01 E06 — Killer Clown: John Wayne Gacy
John Wayne Gacy's sister reveals intimate details of the killer, and returns to her childhood home in Chicago with her daughter.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E02 — Murder Under a Blue Moon
When Richard Smith fails to show up for work, police discover the murdered bodies of Smith, his mother and brother in their home.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E09 — Murder on Middle Mountain
A 13-year-old doesn't show up for a play date and is reported missing, setting off a manhunt in the rough Colorado wilderness; when his badly decomposed remains are found by hikers three years later, prosecutors charge the teen's father with murder.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E10 — Murder in a Cul-de-Sac
On a summer night, Amanda Colley returns to a ransacked house; her love interest Lamar and two girlfriends arrive to join her, and gunshots ring out; Amanda and her friend Lindy are found dead.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E07 — Murder at the Mall
In 1979, 18-year-old high school student Michelle Martinko is found stabbed to death in her car in the parking lot of the Westdale Mall in Cedar Rapids, Iowa; for decades, the mystery of her murder has haunted the town and her family.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S01 E04 — Murder on the Gulf Coast
When the body of former police officer Taylor Wright is discovered buried on a remote Florida farm, detectives have a lineup of suspects to investigate including her ex-husband, her new live-in girlfriend, and her best friend.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S02 E07 — The Dallas Love Triangle Murder
Dentist Dr. Kendra Hatcher was in a deep romance with fellow doctor Ricardo Paniagua when she was brutally murdered in the garage of her apartment building.

title: Killer Cases
description:
S03 E03 — The Exchange Student Murder
An exchange student finds a career and a love match in the idyllic Missouri university town of Columbia; it's a shock to her friends and family when she disappears, leaving both her child and cellphone behind.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E06 — Taken in Tacoma
When 13-year-old Jennifer Bastian is abducted and murdered in August 1986, residents of Tacoma, Wash., panic; convinced a predator is on the loose, police embark on a 32-year inquiry to catch the killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E02 — Gone in a New York Minute
Landlord Bruce Blackwood disappears without a trace in March 2006; though there is no body, the NYPD is sure this is a homicide and they, along with Bruce's brother Ed, spend the next nine years searching for answers and a killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E05 — Vanished in Virginia
When 30-year-old mother Lisa Gaudenzi fails to report for duty in Virginia, the Army lists her as AWOL; her family immediately suspects foul play, so they embark on a 13-year quest for answers before an eyewitness blows the case wide open.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E01 — Killer in the Storm
In the heart of Cajun country, young mother Brenda DuPont is found murdered in her home in May 1988. The initial investigation sputters and turns cold, but Brenda's older sister Linda vows to solve Brenda's murder, no matter how long it takes.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S03 E04 — Death of a Hero
A fire in January 2007 claims the life of WWII vet Bennie Angelo; a closer look at the crime scene reveals Bennie was dead before the fire, bumping an arson case up to homicide.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E14 — No Known Enemies
When the body of 81-year-old Helen Gale is found in her burned-out car, investigators in Southfield, Mich., wonder who would murder this pillar of the community; it will be eight years before a blown alibi brings them face-to face with her killer.

title: Cold Case Files
description:
S04 E11 — Blood Red Snow
When Chris Green, 19, is found beaten to death in a snowy Bangor, Michigan, ditch in 2002, his family fears their son's murder will never be solved; years pass before shocking revelations from an informant emerge and blow the case wide open.
